mft_h264.note: The H.264 encoder Media Foundation transform (M15.11). register true: the installer copies payload/mft/amdgpu_wddm_mft_h264.dll to <install root>\mft\ and writes route A of driver/umd/mft-h264/INSTALL.md machine wide. register false: the installer installs and registers nothing, and takes away what an earlier install of this release family wrote. The value travels into manifest.json, so the package itself says what it does. This is the bisect lever of the encoder wagon.

files.role: KMD 0.7.216.22 INF (bc250-win 0d6b3299, train/b23). New against 0.7.216.14, each with NOCLOBBER and the value of tools/release/installer/registry-defaults.json: HangRecoveryMode 1 (M15.12 stage 1, 0 is the 0.7.216.14 driver), EnableDisplayModes 2 (EDID over DP AUX, the monitor descriptor, smaller modes scaled; 1 centered, 0 the one inherited mode) and EnableScanoutPlaneFormats 1 (RGBA8 and RGB10A2 flips; 0 flips B8G8R8A8 only). A tester.20 computer has none of the three, so it gets the defaults. ReportAmdDriverVersion is read from HKLM\SOFTWARE\amdgpu-wddm\Graphics, and the INF does not write it. Every earlier rule of the 0.7.216.14 INF is kept (BD-091 defaults table, the two unconditional writes, the absent memory manager switches). The release re-stamps DriverVer and adds the Reboot directive

KMD 0.7.216.22, escape ABI 0x000700D8, unchanged from 0.7.216.1 (bc250-win 0d6b3299, train/b23: the tester.20 driver 0.7.216.14 with the b23 kernel wagons). New in b23, each one a Parameters value away from the behaviour before it. M15.12 stage-1 hang recovery (HangRecoveryMode, absent = 1): a node-0 engine reset kills the hung job's VMID waves through the GFX register path and, when the ring drains, reports the reset as done, so only the process of the hung job loses its device; the verdicts go to Parameters\HangRecovery. Display modes stage A (EnableDisplayModes 2): the EDID over DP AUX, the monitor descriptor, the native mode and smaller sizes scaled by the DCN scaler at the native timing, and the DP audio endpoint takes its sink from the EDID (step 4). Per-flip plane pixel formats RGBA8 and RGB10A2 for independent flip, with the firmware's B8G8R8A8 written back at stop, bugcheck and the desktop's next flip (EnableScanoutPlaneFormats 1), and the scan-out caps trailer carries the committed source mode. The telemetry block runs every 60 s at the DPM idle point, so the 1024-line ring keeps its events (BD-097). Start health CONFIRMED follows the confirmed start generation through mode and visibility changes (BD-098). ReportAmdDriverVersion 1 of HKLM\SOFTWARE\amdgpu-wddm\Graphics makes the start write an AMD-scheme DriverVersion into the adapter's software key and puts the installed number back when the setting is cleared (C69). The CPU restore baseline is the highest clock the firmware answered over the P-state table and the per-core clocks, clamped to 3500 MHz, so a revert, a reset or the end of the joint arm's cap gives back the firmware boost, not the 3200 MHz table top (BD-094, K137, 424b2945). The kernel is built with /Brepro and a sorted object list. The b22 changes: New in b22, each one a Parameters value away from the behaviour before it. A runtime restart of the GPU device inside a confirmed boot works: an orderly stop gives the boot-loop guard its start back, a second teardown of the same device is refused by a StopDone guard instead of running twice, the release of the display fills the scanned-out surface with black, and CreateDevice logs the process it answered (BD-090). The DisplayPort audio path reads the Azalia, DIO and DCCG state for the check table and clears DIO_MEM_PWR_CTRL before it enables the stream, as Linux dcn201_init_hw does. The clock governor holds its idle point while the work on the GPU still fits that point (DpmIdleLeavePermille 150), which stops the 500 and 1000 MHz flapping of an idle desktop, and it carries the C62 joint power arm that caps the processor for a bound and hot GPU, behind DpmJointGovernor, which is 0 in this release. Memory manager stage 1: the OS aperture is 384 MiB (ApertureSegmentMegabytes, absent = 384, clamped to 256..447, one fallback to 256 if the GART refuses), a VRAM allocation of the user-mode driver that is neither a scan-out surface nor DISCARDABLE is also resident in the aperture segment so Windows can move it to system memory instead of evicting it (EnableSharedResidency, absent = 1), and the vidmm and paging counters now report what moved. The SMU owner is refused with a log line instead of a failed start when BAR5 is not mapped, and the log ring is kept in one file per device start and per stop under C:/BC250/kmdlog, with 200-file pruning (BD-091). The kernel is built with /Brepro and a sorted object list, and two builds of this head into empty directories gave the same unsigned and signed bytes. The b21 changes against 0.7.213.1 are all here too, each on by every install with one Parameters value that takes it away again. A VMID per page-table root from a pool of up to 14, so a job of another process does not wait for the ring to drain (EnableVmidPool, 0.7.214). The case fan control: the driver takes fan 1 from the BIOS curve while it runs, drives it on its own curve (Standard: 100 % from 80 C) and gives it back to the chip on every exit path, through escape 30 RUN_FAN (EnableFanControl); a leased mode ends with the durable mode from before it. DisplayPort audio steps 0 to 2: the Azalia endpoint of the running DP stream is configured, the audio stream of that DP encoder is started (audio DTO1, AFMT, DP SEC), and only then is the endpoint present to the inbox HD Audio driver, through escape 31 RUN_DPAUDIO ABI 2 (EnableDpAudio, EnableDpAudioEndpoint, EnableDpAudioStream; 0.7.215.1 showed the endpoint with no audio clock, so no sound and video at about 0.7x). The SMU metrics table once a second for the package power, RUN_DPM ABI 3; a 0 mW table is a skipped sample (EnableSmuMetrics). The CPU tuning surface is open by default (CpuTune 1): a change runs only on an administrator's request, as a trial that reverts by itself. Re-signed with the release certificate, code unchanged

D3D12 shell (bc250-win 0d6b3299, train/b23). New against the tester.20 shell: a scan-out primary carries the 64-byte E26R v3 record that the compositor opens, and the shell asks for scan-out only when every clause of scanout-mode.h holds (M15.14 increment 2, main b79442ca). A ray tracing state object that imports collections accepts their inherited summary associations, the shell synthesizes the ALLOW_STATE_OBJECT_ADDITIONS configuration that the runtime of unit A drops, and thunk refusals of the state object slots are clamped (BD-095, The Ascent). The adapter reports shader model 6.8, 6.7 with the profile switch shader-model-68-off and 6.6 with shader-model-67-off. The shell applies the per-application graphics settings FrameRateLimit, VSync (the Present override) and Anisotropy (VKD3D_SAMPLER_ANISOTROPY for the engine), and logs MaxFrameLatency and PerformanceOverlay as not applied. Every earlier behaviour of the tester.20 shell is kept. Built with /Brepro, and builds at 9518c976 and 0f71caac gave the same bytes

D3D12 engine (vkd3d-proton fork amdgpu-wddm/per-app-graphics-settings 41bd52c8 = 4e9a98e9 plus one commit: VKD3D_SAMPLER_ANISOTROPY sets the maximum anisotropy of static samplers and sampler descriptors with a linear minification filter, limited to maxSamplerAnisotropy; dxil-spirv d2d82332). D3D12 ICD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b23-icd 8c110468, radv-mt recipe of b19, static CRT). On top of the b19 ICD 31844893: a fence wait on a live device waits in 1 s slices up to 120 s and stops early only on a host loss (K225, 154050d5), and MakeResident asks with CantTrimFurther, not MustSucceed, so an allocation over the budget pages other memory out instead of putting the device in error (BD-096, 7f16adb0). H.264 encoder Media Foundation transform (bc250-win 689852a8, train/b20-setup, which carries e52/encoder-perf e4d1f630). The respin does not rebuild it: no commit of the respin touches driver/umd/mft-h264 or the contract headers it includes, so this is the file the tester.14 build staged, and the lab kit of E52 pins it. The encoder holds two pictures at once, it filters a whole picture in one dispatch, and its rate control reads the quantiser the content needs. A client that asks for low latency still gets one picture at a time. BC250_MFT_DEPTH=1, BC250_MFT_DEBLOCK=waves and BC250_MFT_SERIAL_DEBLOCK each select an older part. The conformance sweep is 76 of 76, and 60 of 60 pictures stay bit exact against the inbox decoder. The build matches the hash the wagon recorded
